segments.he: אַהֲבָה בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא אֶחָד. [ליקו"מ ד']
segments.en:
"Not one of them remained" (א׳חד מ׳הם ל׳א נ׳ותר) [Exodus 14:28] — first letters spell אלמן (almon, "widower"). [Cross-reference from Almon below.]
 
 Chayay Mooharan §469

 א׳חת מ׳הנה ל׳א נ׳שברה
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 "Not one of them was broken" (א׳חת מ׳הנה ל׳א נ׳שברה) [Psalms 34:21] — first letters spell אלמן (almon, "widower"). [Cross-reference from Almon below.]
 
 Sefer HaMidos, "Almon" 2:2

 אייר
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The month of Iyar (אייר) — its letters are the first letters of א׳ויבי י׳שובו י׳בושו ר׳גע: "May my enemies turn back and be shamed in an instant" [Psalms 6:11].
 
 Likutay Mooharan 277

 אֵיפָה
 
 Notarikon

 Aifah (אֵיפָה, a dry measure / "where?") is read as אֵי פֶּה — "Where is the mouth?" — an allusion to the concealment of divine speech in exile.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 49:6

 איש, פי, זה
 
 Notarikon

 The words איש, פי, זה ("this man, my mouth") are the notarikon expansion of אושפיזא (ushpiza, the mystical Sukkos guest). [Cross-reference from Ushpiza above.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:77; Chayay Mooharan §163

 איתן
 
 Tziroof

segments.he: אֶסַק שָׁמַיִם וְגוֹ' אוֹתִיּוֹת קסא. [ליקו"מ ו']
segments.en:
Eisahn (איתן, "perennial / mighty") — its letters are a permutation of תניא (tanya, "it has been taught" — the classic Talmudic opening).
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:5; 15

 אֹכֶלֶת
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Ocheles (אֹכֶלֶת, "consuming / devouring fire") — first letters of א׳תה ת׳שלם ל׳איש כ׳מעשהו: "You repay each man according to his deeds" [Psalms 62:13]. [Cross-reference from that verse below.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 187

 א׳כן ר׳וח ה׳וא ב׳אנוש
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "Indeed, it is the spirit within man" [Job 32:8] spell ארבה (arbeh, "locust"). [Cross-reference from Arbeh below.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 64:6

 אל
 
 Gematria

 The Divine Name El (אל), spelled out in full twice (אלף למד × 2), equals the gematria of קרע (kara, "tearing [of the heavenly decree]").
 
 Likutay Mooharan 21:9

 אל אלקים
 
 Gematria

 The Names El Elokim (אל אלקים), spelled out in full as אלף למד — אלף למד הי יוד מם, have the gematria of תהלים (Tehillim, "Psalms" = 485).

 The verse "El, Elokim, Hashem spoke" (אל אלקים ה׳ דבר) [Psalms 50:1] — these four words together have the gematria of שמחה (simchah, "joy").
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 205; 2:5

segments.he: אָדָם אוֹתִיּוֹת אָלֶף דָּם. [שָׁם]
segments.en:
אל דמי / אלקים
 
 Tziroof

 Al Domi (אל דמי, "do not be silent / give yourself no rest") is formed from the letters of Elokim (אלקים) — and conversely, the word Elokim can yield al domi. Similarly, Eldad (אלדד) is read as אֵל דַּד — "the G-d of the breast [nourishment]."
 
 Likutay Mooharan 97

 א׳ל ש׳די י׳תן ל׳כם ר׳חמים
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "May El Sha-dai grant you mercy" [Genesis 43:14] spell ישראל (Yisrael).
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:62

 א׳לה מ'ועדי י'י
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "These are the appointed times of Hashem" [Leviticus 23:2] spell אמי (imi, "my mother"). [Cross-reference: Imi → same verse, listed below.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 30:5

 אלקים
 
 Gematria

 Elokim (אלקים = 86) = gematria of כוס (kos, "cup").

 Elokim twice (172) = עקב (aikev, "heel / consequence").

 Elokim twice (172) plus its 10 letters = 182 = יעקב (Yaakov).

segments.he: אַמָּה רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת אֵשׁ מַיִם ה' מוֹצָאוֹת הַפֶּה. [ליקו"מ ט']
segments.en:
Elokim in squared and filled form = אֹר (or, "light").

 Elokim three times (258) = גרון (gayrohn, "throat").

 Notarikon

 Elokim = יה אלם — "the silent Yah" [the concealed aspect of the Name Yah].

 Tziroof

 From Elokim one can form אל דמי (see above). [Cross-references consolidated.]
 
 
 Chayay Mooharan §577; Likutay Mooharan 41; 277; 46; 177; 97

 אלול
 
 Roshay Saveivos (×3)

 The month of Elul yields three first-letter acronyms:

 (1) א׳ת ל׳בבך ו׳את ל׳בב — "your heart and the heart [of your children]" [Deut. 30:6];

 (2) ו׳אם ל׳א תאבה האשה ל׳לכת א׳חריך — "if the woman does not wish to follow you" [Deut. 21:11 — the soul's return to G-d];

segments.he: אֱמֶת רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת אַמָּה תְּכַלֶּנָּה מִלְמַעְלָה. [שם]
segments.en:
(3) ל׳בושה ו׳תשחק ל׳יום א׳חרון — "She is clothed with strength and laughs at the final day" [Proverbs 31:25].
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 141; 21:11; Likutay Mooharan II:87; Chayay Mooharan §39

 אליהו
 
 Gematria

 Eliyahu (אליהו = 52) = gematria of בן (ben, "son" = 52). [Cross-reference from Ben in Section 2.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 117

 אליעזר
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "an eye has not seen, O G-d, besides You, what You shall do" (ע׳ין ל׳א ר׳אתה א׳לקים ז׳ולתך י׳עשה) [Isaiah 64:3] spell אליעזר (Eliezer — Avraham's servant, the model of hidden divine providence).
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:7; 13

 אלם — יוד אותיות אלקים
 
 Notarikon

 Alam (אלם, "mute / silent") — a Yud (י) plus the letters Alam = the letters of Elokim (אלקים). The Name Elokim is thus the silent Name (alam) activated by the Yud.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 177

 אלמן
 
 Roshay Saveivos (×3)

 Almon (אלמן, "widower") yields three first-letter acronyms:

 (1) א׳חד מ׳הם ל׳א נ׳ותר — "not one of them remained" [Exodus 14:28];

segments.he: אֵשֶׁת רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת אֲדֹנָי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח. [ליקו"מ י']
segments.en:
(2) א׳חת מ׳הנה ל׳א נ׳שברה — "not one of them was broken" [Psalms 34:21];

 (3) מ׳ה נ׳מלצו ל׳חכי א׳מרתך — "How sweet are Your words to my palate!" [Psalms 119:103].
 
 Chayay Mooharan §469; Sefer HaMidos "Almon" 2:2; Likutay Mooharan 199

 אָלֶף
 
 Notarikon

 The name of the letter Alef cannot be pronounced without the letter Peh (פ) — for Peh means "mouth," and the silent Alef secretly requires the mouth / speech to be expressed. [Cross-reference: Aleph-Beis above; also Aish below.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 83

 א׳לף דם — אדם
 
 Tziroof

 The words אלף דם — "Alef [and] blood" — are the letters of אדם (Adam, "Man"). [Cross-reference from Adam above.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 6:5

 א׳לף ת׳יו ה׳
 
 Gematria

 Alef, Tav, Heh (א׳תה — "You" — spelled out as אלף תיו ה׳) has the gematria of five times the phrase ורב חסד ("and abundant in loving-kindness" [Exodus 34:6]).
 
 Chayay Mooharan §136

 אלָפים
 
 Tziroof

 Alafim (אלפים, "thousands") — its letters are a permutation of פלאים (pla'im, "wonders / miracles"). Hidden within "thousands" is the root of "wonders."
 
 Sichos HaRan 4

segments.he: אֵשֶׁת רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת אֲבָנִים שְׁלֵמוֹת תִּבְנֶה. [ליקו"מ י"ח]
segments.en:
אַמָּה
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Amah (אַמָּה, "cubit / forearm") — first letters of א׳ש מ׳ים ה׳ מוצאות הפה: "fire, water, [and] the five articulations of the mouth." [Cross-reference: Aish Mayim → Amah, listed below.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 9:3; 112

 א׳מה ת׳כלנה מ׳למעלה
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "waters are consumed from above" [Job 6:17] spell אמת (emes, "truth"). [Cross-reference: Emes → same verse, listed below.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 9:3

 אמונה
 
 Gematria

 Emunah (אמונה, "faith" = 102) = gematria of בנים (banim, "children" = 102). Faith and children are bound together.
 
 Sichos HaRan 34; Chayay Mooharan §477

 אמי
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Imi (אמי, "my mother") — first letters of א׳לה מ׳ועדי י׳י: "These are the appointed times of Hashem" [Leviticus 23:2]. [Cross-reference from that verse above.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 30:5

 א׳מן כ׳ן י׳הי ר׳צון
 
 Roshay Saveivos (double)

 The first letters of "Amen, so may it be Your will" are also the first letters of כ׳י א׳ני י׳י ר׳ופאך: "For I am Hashem your Healer" [Exodus 15:26]. Saying Amen with full intention invokes the Name of healing.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:42; Chayay Mooharan §53

segments.he: אֱלוּל רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת לְבוּשָׁהּ וַתִּשְׂחַק לְיוֹם אַחֲרוֹן. [ליקו"מ כ"א]
segments.en:
אֹמֶר
 
 Roshay Saveivos (×2)

 Omer (אֹמֶר, "utterance / word") yields two first-letter sources:

 (1) א׳ור מ׳ים ר׳קיע — "light, water, firmament" [the three Creation-elements];

 (2) א׳ש מ׳ים ר׳וח — "fire, water, wind" [the three elemental forces].
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 37:6; II:5:2

 אמת
 
 Tziroof

 Emes (אמת, "truth") is formed by the beginning, middle, and end of the Hebrew alphabet — Alef (first), Mem (middle), Tav (last) — teaching that truth encompasses all of reality from beginning to end.

 Roshay Saveivos

 Emes — first letters of א׳מה ת׳כלנה מ׳למעלה: "waters are consumed from above" [Job 6:17].
 
 Likutay Mooharan 112; 9:3

 אני / אנכי
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Ani (אני, "I") — first letters of א׳נא נ׳פשי י׳הבית: "I hereby give over my very soul" [opening of the hymn Ana BeKoach]. The deepest meaning of "I" is total self-surrender to G-d.

segments.he: אָוֶן רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת וַי אָבְדָה נָפֶשׁ. [ליקו"מ ל"א]
segments.en:
Anochi (אנכי, "I" — the more emphatic form, the first word of the Ten Commandments) — first letters of א׳נא נ׳פשי כ׳תיבת י׳הבית: "I hereby give over my soul in writing."
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 173; 73

 א׳נא נ׳פשי י׳הבית
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "I hereby give over my very soul" spell אני (ani, "I"). [Cross-reference from Ani above.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 173

 אסק
 
 Tziroof

 The letters א, ס, ק rearranged spell the Divine Name קס"א (= 161, the full-spelling of the Name Ehyeh with Yuds).
 
 Likutay Mooharan 6:7

 אסתר
 
 Gematria

 Esther (אסתר = 661) = gematria of שושנה (shoshana, "rose / lily" = 661). Esther is the rose of Israel, hidden yet fragrant.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:74

 אף / פ"א
 
 Tziroof

 Af (אף, "nose / anger") — its letters reversed spell פ"א (Peh-Alef, the name of the letter Peh = "mouth"). Anger is the inversion of holy speech.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 83

 אפי
 
 Roshay Saveivos

segments.he: אֹמֶר רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת אוֹר מַיִם רָקִיעַ. [ליקו"מ ל"ז]
segments.en:
Api (אפי, "my nose / my wrath") — first letters of פ׳ותח א׳ת י׳דיך: "You open Your hand" [Psalms 145:16]. G-d's wrath is transformed into open-handed generosity.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 66:2

 ארבה
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Arbeh (ארבה, "locust") — first letters of א׳כן ר׳וח ה׳וא ב׳אנוש: "Indeed, it is the spirit within man" [Job 32:8].
 
 Likutay Mooharan 64:6

 ארבע מאות
 
 Gematria (×2)

 Four hundred (= 400) = (1) gematria of סנפיר (snapir, "fin of a fish"); and (2) gematria of רע עין (ra ayin, "evil eye").
 
 Sichos HaRan 242

 ארגמן
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Argaman (ארגמן, "purple / crimson") — first letters of the five archangels: א׳וריאל ר׳פאל ג׳בריאל מ׳יכאל נ׳וריאל — Uriel, Rephael, Gavriel, Micha'el, Nuri'el.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:5; 12

 אש
 
 Gematria (×2)

 Aish (אש, "fire" = 301) = gematria of the six letters whose names require a Peh: א, כ, ך, פ, ף, ק (= 1+20+20+80+80+100 = 301).

 Aish also = gematria of כסף במילואו (kesef bemiluo, "silver in its full-spelling") — the word kesef spelled out in full equals 301.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 83; Chayay Mooharan §600

segments.he: אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק יַעֲקֹב רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְיָ. [ליקו"מ מ"ב]
segments.en:
א׳ש מ׳ים ה׳ מוצאות הפה
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "fire, water, [and] the five articulations of the mouth" spell אמה (amah, "cubit"). [Cross-reference from Amah above.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 9:3; 112

 אש ומים — שמים
 
 Tziroof

 Aish u'Mayim (אש ומים, "fire and water") — the letters of both words together spell שמים (shamayim, "heaven"). The heavens are a union of fire and water.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 17:2; 80; 88; 114

 א׳ש מ׳ים ר׳וח
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "fire, water, wind" (א׳ש מ׳ים ר׳וח) spell אֹמֶר (omer, "utterance"). [Cross-reference from Omer above.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:5:2

 א׳ש ר׳וח מ׳ים ע׳פר
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "fire, wind, water, earth" — the four elements — are also the first letters of מ׳שפיל ר׳שעים ע׳די א׳רץ: "He brings the wicked down to the dust" [Psalms 147:6].
 
 Likutay Mooharan 8:5

 אשה
 
 Gematria

 Ishah (אשה, "woman" = 306) = gematria of דבש (devash, "honey" = 306).

segments.he: אִשָּׁה רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת הַנֹּתֵן אִמְרֵי שָׁפֶר. [ליקו"מ מ"ז]
segments.en:
Roshay Saveivos

 Ishah — first letters of ה׳נותן א׳מרי ש׳פר: "He who grants eloquent speech" [Job 35:4 / see source]. A woman embodies the gift of beautiful, eloquent expression.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 199; 47

 א׳שרי נ׳שוי פ׳שע
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "Fortunate is one whose transgression is forgiven" (א׳שרי נ׳שוי פ׳שע) [Psalms 32:1] spell נאף (na'af, "licentiousness / adultery").
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 205

 אשת
 
 Roshay Saveivos (×3)

 Eshes (אשת, "woman / wife") yields three first-letter sources:

 (1) א׳בנים ש׳למות ת׳בנה — "You shall build with whole stones" [Deut. 27:6];

 (2) א׳דני ש׳פתי ת׳פתח — "My L-rd, open my lips" [Psalms 51:17];

 (3) ש׳בו א׳יש ת׳חתיו — "Let each man remain in his place" [Exodus 16:29].
 
 Likutay Mooharan 18:6; 10:4; 79

 את
 
 Notarikon

 Es (את, the Hebrew direct-object marker) represents all the letters from Alef to Tav — the totality of the Hebrew alphabet and of all creation.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 94

segments.he: אַלֻּף רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת לְהַתִּיר פֶּה אִלְּמִים. [ליקו"מ ס']
segments.en:
א׳ת ל׳בבך ו׳את ל׳בב
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "your heart and the heart [of your children]" [Deuteronomy 30:6] spell אלול (Elul). [Cross-reference from Elul above.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 141; Chayay Mooharan §39

 א׳ת נ׳פש ה׳גר כ׳י
 
 Sofay Saveivos

 The final letters of א׳ת נ׳פש ה׳גר כ׳י — "the soul of the stranger, for..." [Exodus 23:9] — spell תשרי (Tishrei), the first month of the Jewish year.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:8; 11

 א׳תה ג׳בור ל׳עולם א׳דני
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "You are mighty forever, my L-rd" [opening of the second blessing of Shmoneh Esrai] spell the Divine Name אגלא (Agla).
 
 Likutay Mooharan 5:5

 א׳תה ס׳תר ל׳י
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "You are my shelter" [Psalms 32:7] spell the Divine Name סאל (Sa'el).

 The first letters of "You are my shelter from distress" (א׳תה ס׳תר ל׳י מ׳צר) [ibid.] spell סמאל (Sama'el — the prosecuting angel).
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 5; 213

 א׳תה ת׳שלם ל׳איש כ׳מעשהו
 
 Roshay Saveivos

segments.he: אַרְבֶּה רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת אָכֵן רוּחַ הִיא בֶאֱנוֹשׁ. [ליקו"מ ס"ד]
segments.en:
The first letters of "You repay each man according to his deeds" [Psalms 62:13] spell אֹכֶלֶת (ocheles, "consuming fire"). [Cross-reference from Ocheles above.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 187

 א׳תרוג ה׳דס ע׳רבה
 
 Gematria

 The first letters of three of the Four Species — esrog, hadas, aravah — together with the letters of those initials, have the same gematria as בְּיֵין ("with wine").
 
 Sefer HaMidos, "Eating" 2:13; "Garments" 2:7

BAIS — Numerical Value: 2 | First letter of the Torah | 52 source entries

 
 Hebrew Entry
 English Translation & Explanation
 Source
 

 ב׳ ראשית
 
 Notarikon

 The word Bereishis (בראשית, "In the beginning") is read as ב׳ ראשית — "Bais is the beginning." The Torah begins with Bais because Bais is the letter of berachah (blessing) and of the revealed world.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 49:6

 באר
 
 Tziroof

 Be'er (באר, "a well") — its letters are a permutation of רַבָּא (Rabbah, "the great one" — Aramaic title of greatness). The well of Torah is the well of greatness.

 Roshay Saveivos

segments.he: אַפִּי רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת פּוֹתֵחַ אֶת יָדֶךָ. [ליקו"מ ס"ו]
segments.en:
Be'er — first letters of ב׳שמעו א׳ת ר׳נתם: "when they heard their [joyful] song" [Numbers 21:17 — the Song of the Well].
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 177; 27:5

 ב׳דבר י׳י ש׳מים נ׳עשו
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "By the word of Hashem the heavens were made" (ב׳דבר י׳י ש׳מים נ׳עשו) [Psalms 33:6] spell נביא (navi, "prophet") — for the Alef [silent, invisible] is the firmament [rakia] through which divine speech travels to become prophecy.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:1; 9

 בְּהִבָּרְאָם
 
 Tziroof

 BeHibaram (בְּהִבָּרְאָם, "when they were created" [Genesis 2:4]) — its letters are a permutation of באברהם ("through Avraham"). The Midrash teaches: the world was created in the merit of Avraham — and his name is hidden in the very word for Creation.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 67:7; II:2; 3

 ב׳זעת א׳פיך ת׳אכל ל׳חם
 
 Multiple

 The first letters (roshay saveivos) of "By the sweat of your brow you shall eat bread" (ב׳זעת א׳פיך ת׳אכל ל׳חם) [Genesis 3:19], together with the gematria of all four words, connect to the laws of shechitah (ritual slaughter).
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 37:6

 בְּיֵין
 
 Gematria

 BeYayin (בְּיֵין, "with wine"), together with its letters, has the same gematria as the first letters of the three species: א׳תרוג ה׳דס ע׳רבה — esrog, hadas, aravah. [Cross-reference from Esrog Hadas Aravah in Section 1.]
 
 Sefer HaMidos, "Eating" 2:13; "Garments" 2:7

 בַּיָם / בַּכֹּל
 
 Gematria

segments.he: אֵשֶׁת רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת שְׁבוּ אִישׁ תַּחְתָּיו. [ליקו"מ ע']
segments.en:
BaYam (בַּיָם, "in the sea" = 52) = gematria of BaKol (בַּכֹּל, "in everything" = 52) — and vice versa. The sea and totality are numerically one: to be truly in the sea of Torah is to be in everything.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 38:7

 ב׳ית ת׳חלק ש׳לל
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "the house divides the spoil" (ב׳ית ת׳חלק ש׳לל) [Psalms 68:13] spell שבת (Shabbos). The division of Shabbos from the weekdays brings the ultimate spoil — rest and holiness.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 49:7; Sichos HaRan 86

 בכי / בכיה
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 (1) ב׳ני י׳שראל כ׳חול ה׳ים — "the children of Israel [are] as the sand of the sea" [Hosea 2:1];

 (2) ב׳שמך י׳גילון כ׳ל ה׳יום — "in Your Name they rejoice all the day" [Psalms 89:17].

 The first letters of "a virgin is married on the fourth day [Wednesday]" (ב׳תולה נ׳שאת ל׳יום ה׳רביעי) [Mishnah, Kesuvos 1:1] spell לבנה (levanah, "the moon"). The marriage of a virgin on Wednesday — the day the moon was created — reveals the lunar connection embedded in the laws of marriage.

 Gematria

דַּוָי
 
 Tziroof

 Davay (דַּוָי, "sickness / faintness") — its letters are a permutation of יוד (Yud — the spelling of the letter Yud). Illness at its root is a distortion and displacement of the holy Yud — the divine spark of vitality.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:82

 דַּיּוֹ
 
 Notarikon

 Dayyo (דַּיּוֹ, "it is enough for him" — the Haggadah's famous refrain; also: "ink") embodies the aspect of דְּיוֹ (dyo, "ink") — for divine speech is like ink that inscribes the world into being.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 192; Chayay Mooharan §69

 דין × 5
 
 Gematria (×2)

 Din (דין, "judgment" = 64) five times (5 × 64 = 320) equals:

 (1) The gematria of נער (naar, "a youth / lad" = 320);

 (2) The gematria of ש"ך דינים (Shin-Chaf judgments = 320) — the 320 harsh judgments that must be sweetened through Torah, prayer, and joy.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 32

 דלת
 
 Shape / Form (×3)

 The letter Dalet yields three shape-teachings:

segments.he: אֱלוּל רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת וְאִם לֹא תֹאבֶה הָאִשָּׁה לָלֶכֶת אַחֲרֶיךָ. [ליקו"מ ח"ב פ"ז]
segments.en:
(1) Two Dalets together form the shape of a closed Mem (ם sofit — the final sealed form of Mem);

 (2) A Dalet together with a Yud and a Vov (דלת יוד ואו) forms the shape of an Alef;

 (3) When a Yud (י) is drawn into [the open space of] a Dalet, it becomes a Heh (ה) — the divine spark (Yud) entering the vessel of poverty (Dalet = dalus) transforms it into the letter of the Divine Name.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 135; 185; 49:3

segments.en:
ה — three forms
 
 Shape / Form

 The letter Heh in its three written forms, together with 2 kollelim, has the gematria of חלב (chalav, "milk") — the nourishing whiteness of Torah.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 97

 ה — five articulations
 
 Shape / Form

 The letter Heh embodies the five articulations of the mouth (ה׳ מוצאות הפה) — the five places from which all speech emerges: throat, palate, tongue, teeth, and lips. The letter Heh is itself produced with pure breath alone, the most elemental of all sounds.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 9:3; 57:8

 ד → ה
 
 Shape / Form

 The Dalet (ד) was [originally] a Heh (ה) — and it returned and became a Heh again. The gap at the bottom-left of the Heh is the mouth through which breath and speech emerge; the Dalet lacks this opening. [Cross-reference from Section 4.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 49:3

 ה — breath
 
 Shape / Form

 The letter Heh embodies the aspect of hevel peh (הבל פה) — "the breath of the mouth." It is produced with pure exhalation, without any constriction or obstruction.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 77

 ה — five books
 
 Notarikon

 The letter Heh (= 5) corresponds to the five books of the Torah (חמשה חומשי תורה).
 
 Likutay Mooharan 101

segments.en:
ה = ד + י
 
 Shape / Form (×2)

 The letter Heh is:

 (1) A Dalet (ד) together with a Yud (י) — the small floating foot at the bottom-left of the Heh;

 (2) Equivalently: a Yud and a Dalet — the divine point joined to the vessel.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 49:5; 49:3; 97

 ה → ק
 
 Shape / Form

 When the leg of the Heh (ה) is lengthened downward, it becomes the letter Kuf (ק). The Kuf's descending leg reaches below the baseline — alluding to the divine light that descends into and illuminates the lower worlds.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 167:4

 ה׳ חסדים
 
 Notarikon

 The five chassadim (ה׳ חסדים, "five acts of lovingkindness") correspond to the word צדקה (tzedakah, "charity / righteousness") — which appears five times in the Torah in specific passages discussed in the source.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 67:5

 ה׳ כנפי ריאה
 
 Notarikon

 The five lobes of the lung (ה׳ כנפי ריאה) correspond to the five books of the Torah. The lung — organ of breath, of the letter Heh — mirrors the Torah in its fivefold structure.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 8:9; 267

segments.he: אֶחָד רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת דִּבְרֵי אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים. [השמטה משיחות הר"ן]
segments.en:
הויה
 
 Gematria (×5)

 The four-letter Divine Name (הויה — Havayah, the ineffable Name) yields multiple gematria connections:

 (1) Spelled out in full with Yuds (יוד קי ואו קי) = the Divine Name ס"ג [63 — the Name of Binah];

 (2) Spelled out with Alefs (milui Alfin) = gematria of Adam [45 — the Name of Ze'ir Anpin];

 (3) Three times (3 × 26 = 78) = gematria of חֹלָם (cholam — the vowel-dot above, representing the supernal hidden light);

 (4) Contains 10 letters in its full spelling and 4 letters in its simple form — 10+4 = 14 = יד ("hand") — the Name of G-d is the divine Hand;

 (5) Three times Havayah (78) plus three times Elokim (258) = 336 = gematria of שלו (shalev, "tranquil / at peace"). The union of mercy and judgment produces peace.

 And: Havayah and Elokim in their "backwards" (achorayim) spelling = gematria of רעב (ra'av, "hunger / famine"). When the "face" of the Names is withdrawn, spiritual hunger results.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 6:7; II:82; II:3; 46; 62:5

 ה׳זה כ׳גודל ח׳סדך ו׳כאשר נ׳שאת
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "According to the greatness of Your lovingkindness, and as You have forgiven" (ה׳זה כ׳גודל ח׳סדך ו׳כאשר נ׳שאת) [Numbers 14:19 — Moshe's great plea for forgiveness in the desert] spell חנוכה (Chanukah). The miracle of Chanukah is encoded in Moshe's greatest act of intercession.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:7; 11

segments.he: אֲדָר רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת רֹאשׁ דְּבָרְךָ אֱמֶת. [שם]
segments.en:
ה׳יולי נ׳בדל ג׳לגל ש׳פל
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "the primal matter is separated, the lowly wheel" (ה׳יולי נ׳בדל ג׳לגל ש׳פל) — a philosophical phrase describing the spinning of the material world — also spell ה׳נ׳ג׳ש׳, the four letters of the dreidel.
 
 
 Sichos HaRan 40

 היכל
 
 Gematria

 Haichal (היכל, "the Sanctuary / Divine Palace" = 65) equals the gematria of the Divine Name Adonai (אדני = 65). The Sanctuary is the physical embodiment of the Name Adonai. [Cross-reference from Adonai in Section 1.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 55:7; 194; Sichos HaRan 96, 105

 הלכה
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Halachah (הלכה, "Jewish law / the way one walks") — its letters are the first letters of ה׳ריעו ל׳יי כ׳ל ה׳ארץ: "Shout joyfully to Hashem, all the earth!" [Psalms 100:1]. Jewish law is a shout of joy to G-d. [Cross-reference: the verse itself listed below as a cross-reference.]
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:2; 3

 ה׳מעטריכי ח׳סד ו׳רחמים
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "crowning with lovingkindness and mercy" (ה׳מעטריכי ח׳סד ו׳רחמים) [Psalms 103:4] spell חוה (Chavah — Eve, the first woman). The name of Eve encodes the divine attributes of lovingkindness and compassion — she who gives life is herself a crown of mercy.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:16

 ה׳ן ת׳וי ש׳די י׳ענני
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "Behold, the sign of Sha-dai shall answer me" (ה׳ן ת׳וי ש׳די י׳ענני) [Job 31:35] spell שתיה (shtiyah, "drinking" — and the name of the Foundation Stone of the world, the Even HaShtiyah, upon which the Temple was built and from which the world was "drunk" into existence).
 
 Likutay Mooharan 61:6

segments.he: אָדָם רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת דֶּרֶךְ מִצְוֹתֶיךָ אָרוּץ. [שיחות הר"ן קט"ז]
segments.en:
ה׳נותן א׳מרי ש׳פר
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "He who grants eloquent speech" (ה׳נותן א׳מרי ש׳פר) [Job 35:4 / see source] spell אשה (ishah, "woman"). A woman embodies the divine gift of beautiful, eloquent expression. [Cross-reference from Ishah in Section 1.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 47

 העֹרף
 
 Tziroof

 HaOref (העֹרף, "the back of the neck") — its letters are a perfect permutation of פרעה (Pharaoh). Stubbornness — the "stiff neck" — and Pharaoh share the same letters.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 62:5; 163

 הפר / פרה
 
 Tziroof

 Heifer / Hefar (הפר, "to annul / a young bull") — its letters are a permutation of פרה (parah, "a cow / the Red Heifer"). The Red Heifer (Parah Adumah) purifies the impure and paradoxically renders the one who prepares it impure — the supreme mystery (chok) of Torah.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:74

 הקף × 2
 
 Gematria

 Hakef (הקף, "circuit / encirclement") twice = gematria of ש"ע נהורין ("370 lights") — the 370 radiant lights of the Divine countenance (Atik Yomin) described in the Zohar.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:7; 11

 הָב / ה׳ר ש׳דה ב׳ית / השב
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Hav (הָב, "give!" [Genesis 30:1, Rachel's desperate plea to Yaakov]) — its letters are the first letters of ה׳ר ש׳דה ב׳ית: "mountain, field, house" — the three levels of space in which G-d's presence is encountered: mountain (transcendence), field (open search), house (intimacy).

segments.he: אֱמוּנָה רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת נִפְתְּחוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וָאֶרְאֶה מַרְאוֹת אֱלֹהִים. [ליקו"ה חושן משפט בהקדמה]
segments.en:
HaShev (השב, "return! / restore!") — its letters are equally the first letters of ה׳ר ש׳דה ב׳ית: the same three holy spaces. To restore is to return to mountain, field, and house.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 10:4

 ה׳ריעו ל׳יי כ׳ל ה׳ארץ
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "Shout joyfully to Hashem, all the earth!" [Psalms 100:1] spell הלכה (halachah, "Jewish law"). [Cross-reference from Halachah above.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:2; 3

 ה׳שקיפה מ׳מעון ק׳דשיך
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "Look down from Your holy dwelling" (ה׳שקיפה מ׳מעון ק׳דשיך) [Deuteronomy 26:15 — the declaration made after bringing the bikurim / first fruits] spell קמה (kamah, "standing grain / arising"). G-d's downward gaze from above causes Israel to stand and arise below.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 234

 ה׳שתחוו ל׳יי ב׳הדרת ק׳דש
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "Bow down to Hashem in the beauty of holiness" (ה׳שתחוו ל׳יי ב׳הדרת ק׳דש) [Psalms 29:2] spell קבלה (Kabbalah — "receiving" / the mystical tradition). Kabbalah is bowing in the beauty of holiness.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 11:6

segments.he: אֵלִיָּהוּ רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת וְאַתָּה הוּא וּשְׁנוֹתֶיךָ לֹא יִתָּמּוּ. [שם]
segments.en:
ו — name contains a ו
 
 Notarikon

 The letter Vov (ו) cannot be pronounced without a second Vov — for its name is spelled ואו (Vov-Alef-Vov), which contains another Vov within it.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 83 (appendix)

 ו × 3
 
 Gematria

 The letter Vov three times (3 × 6 = 18) = the gematria of יח (yach — a living creature / the word chai = "life" in its shortened form, 18).
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:83

 ו — drawing of the voice
 
 Shape / Form

 The letter Vov embodies the aspect of hamshachas hakol (המשכת הקול) — "the extension / drawing-out of the voice." Its straight downward form visually represents the elongation of a sustained tone.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 77

 ו — form of a staff
 
 Shape / Form

 The letter Vov has the shape of a staff (מקל) — the vertical line that reaches from above to below, connecting heaven and earth.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 1

 ו — form of a patach
 
 Shape / Form

 The letter Vov has the shape of the vowel-mark patach (ניקוד פתח) — the horizontal line that "opens" (patach = opening) sound and speech.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 66:2

segments.he: אֵלִיָּהוּ רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת הָאָדָם וְהַחַי יִתֵּן אֶל לִבּוֹ. [שם]
segments.en:
ו'אין ע'בירה מ'כבה ת'ורה
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "no sin extinguishes Torah" (ו׳אין ע׳בירה מ׳כבה ת׳ורה) [based on the Talmudic teaching, Sotah 21a] spell מעות (ma'os, "coins / money"). [The connection: giving tzedakah — money — is the antidote to the darkness of sin; it preserves the Torah's light.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 204; Sichos HaRan 136

 ואל'ה שמו'ת בנ'י ישרא'ל הבאי'ם
 
 Sofay Saveivos

 The final letters of "And these are the names of the children of Israel who came" (ואלה שמות בני ישראל הבאים) [Exodus 1:1 — the opening verse of the Book of Exodus] spell תהלים (Tehillim, "Psalms"). The descent into Egypt — the beginning of exile — already contains within its final letters the Book of Psalms: the ultimate book of redemption and prayer.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:73

 ו'אם ל'א תאבה האשה ל'לכת א'חריך
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "and if the woman does not wish to follow you" (ו׳אם ל׳א תאבה האשה ל׳לכת א׳חריך) [Deuteronomy 21:11] spell אלול (Elul). The soul's potential reluctance to return to G-d is encoded in the month designated for that very return. [Cross-reference from Section 5.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:87

 ו'אם מ'פאת פ'ניו י'מרט ר'אשו
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "and if from the front of his head hair is lost" (ו׳אם מ׳פאת פ׳ניו י׳מרט ר׳אשו) [Leviticus 13:41 — laws of leprosy/baldness] spell פורים (Purim). The festival of Purim is encoded in a verse about baldness — the hidden becoming revealed, the concealed face of G-d.
 
 
 Chayay Mooharan §90

 ו'דע מ'ה ש'תשיב ל'אפיקורס
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "know what to answer a heretic" (ו׳דע מ׳ה ש׳תשיב ל׳אפיקורס) [Mishnah, Avos 2:14] spell שלום (shalom, "peace"). The proper response to heresy is — peace: not confrontation, but the wholeness and completeness that leaves no room for doubt.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 62:2

segments.he: אֵלִיָּהוּ רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת וֶאֱמֶת יְיָ לְעוֹלָם הַלְלוּיָהּ. [שם]
segments.en:
וָהֵב
 
 Gematria

 Vahev (וָהֵב — the place-name in Numbers 21:14, associated with the giving of Torah; see Rashi) = gematria of אהבה (ahavah, "love"). [Cross-reference from Section 1.]
 
 Marginal gloss to Likutay Mooharan 56

 ו'היה מ'עשה ה'צדקה ש'לום
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "And the work of righteousness shall be peace" (ו׳היה מ׳עשה ה׳צדקה ש׳לום) [Isaiah 32:17] spell משהו (mashehu, "something / a tiny amount"). The work of charity that brings peace is sometimes just a tiny something — a small act that transforms everything.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 57:8

 ו'המשכילים י'זהירו כ'זוהר ה'רקיע
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "And the wise shall shine like the brightness of the firmament" (ו׳המשכילים י׳זהירו כ׳זוהר ה׳רקיע) [Daniel 12:3] spell the Divine Name יוה"ך (Yud-Vov-Heh-Chaf).
 
 
 Chayay Mooharan §195

 והנה קָמָה
 
 Notarikon

 "And behold, it arose" (והנה קָמָה) [Genesis 37:7 — Yosef's dream of the sheaves] — the word קמה (kamah = 145) embodies the aspect of the Divine Name קמ"ה [= 145].
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 234

 ו'השלך ל'פני פ'רעה י'הי ל'תנין
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "Cast it before Pharaoh — let it become a serpent" (ו׳השלך ל׳פני פ׳רעה י׳הי ל׳תנין) [Exodus 7:9] spell ויפלל (vayipalel, "and he prayed"). [Cross-reference: Vayipalel → same verse, listed below.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:8; 3

segments.he: אֵלִיָּהוּ רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת הֹלֵךְ יְיָ לִפְנֵיכֶם וּמְאַסִּפְכֶם אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל. [ליקו"ה הלכות שתפין, כז]
segments.en:
ו'וי א'בדה נ'פש
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "Woe — the soul is lost!" (ו׳וי א׳בדה נ׳פש) spell אָוֶן (aven, "iniquity"). [Cross-reference from Section 1.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 31:9

 ו'יאמר י'י ס'לחתי כ'דבריך
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "And Hashem said: I have forgiven, as you have spoken" (ו׳יאמר י׳י ס׳לחתי כ׳דבריך) [Numbers 14:20 — G-d's response to Moshe's intercession for Israel] spell כוסי (kosi, "my cup"). Divine forgiveness fills the cup to overflowing.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 177; Chayay Mooharan §117

 ויבן / ו'תקעתיו י'תד ב'מקום נ'אמן
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Vayiven (ויבן, "and he built") — its letters are the first letters of ו׳תקעתיו י׳תד ב׳מקום נ׳אמן: "I will drive him as a peg in a sure place" [Isaiah 22:23]. Building is the act of driving the divine peg into a faithful foundation. [Cross-reference: that verse → Vayiven, listed below.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:1; 2

 ו'יעקב נ'סע ס'כותה ו'יבן
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "And Yaakov journeyed to Sukkos and built" (ו׳יעקב נ׳סע ס׳כותה ו׳יבן) [Genesis 33:17] spell סיון (Sivan) — the Hebrew month of Sivan, the month of the giving of the Torah.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 266, in Meimay HaNachal

 ויפל / ויפלל
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Vayipol (ויפל, "and he fell") — first letters of פ׳ה ל׳הם ו׳לא י׳דברו: "a mouth they have but cannot speak" [Psalms 115:5 — said of idols]. Falling is the condition of the mouth that cannot speak holy words.

segments.he: אַבְרָהָם סוֹפֵי תֵבוֹת לֵב נִשְׁבָּר וְנִדְכֶּה אֱלֹהִים לֹא תִבְזֶה. [שם]
segments.en:
Vayipalel (ויפלל, "and he prayed") — first letters of ו׳השלך ל׳פני פ׳רעה י׳הי ל׳תנין: "Cast it before Pharaoh — let it become a serpent" [Exodus 7:9]. Prayer is the act of casting the holy staff before the powers of the world and watching it become a serpent that swallows all opposition.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 19:4; II:8; 3

 ו'יצא י'צחק ל'שוח ב'שדה
 
 Roshay Saveivos (×2)

 The first letters of "And Yitzchak went out to meditate in the field" (ו׳יצא י׳צחק ל׳שוח ב׳שדה) [Genesis 24:63] yield two readings:

 (1) יבול (yevul, "produce / yield of the earth") — what grows from the earth of hisbodidus (secluded meditation);

 (2) יוֹבל (yovel, "Jubilee year") — the fiftieth year of total release and return.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:11; II:1; 14

 ו'ירא י'י כ'י ס'ר ל'ראות
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "And Hashem saw that he turned to see" (ו׳ירא י׳י כ׳י ס׳ר ל׳ראות) [Exodus 3:4 — at the Burning Bush, the moment G-d called to Moshe] spell כסליו (Kislev) — the Hebrew month of Kislev, the month of Chanukah.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:7; 11

 וישכב
 
 Tziroof

 Vayishkav (וישכב, "and he lay down") — its letters contain יש כ"ב (yesh kaf-beis, "there are 22") — the 22 letters of the Hebrew alphabet are present within the act of lying down / rest.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:79; Sichos HaRan 86

 ו'ישם ל'ך ש'לום
 
 Roshay Saveivos

segments.he: אֱלוּל רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת אִישׁ לְרֵעֵהוּ וּמַתָּנוֹת לָאֶבְיֹנִים. [ליקו"ה אפוטרופוס ב, יא.]
segments.en:
The first letters of "And He shall set peace for you" (ו׳ישם ל׳ך ש׳לום) [Numbers 6:26 — the Priestly Blessing] spell שלו (shalev, "tranquil / at peace"). The blessing of peace already contains its own fulfillment in its first letters.
 
 Chayay Mooharan §78; Likutay Mooharan 46

 ו'כל ב'ניך ל'מודי י'י
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "And all your children shall be taught of Hashem" (ו׳כל ב׳ניך ל׳מודי י׳י) [Isaiah 54:13] spell יוֹבל (yovel, "Jubilee"). When all children are taught the ways of G-d, that itself is the Jubilee — total liberation.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:7; 10

 ו'כתותי מ'פניו צ'ריו
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "I will crush his enemies before him" (ו׳כתותי מ׳פניו צ׳ריו) [Psalms 89:24] spell צום (tzom, "fast"). Fasting crushes the enemies of the soul.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 57:6

 ו'מגיד ל'אדם מ'ה ש'יחו
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "He declares to man what is his conversation / meditation" (ו׳מגיד ל׳אדם מ׳ה ש׳יחו) [Amos 4:13] spell שלום (shalom, "peace"). G-d's declaration of what lies in man's innermost speech is itself peace.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 239

 ו'נח מ'צא ח'ן ב'עיני י'י
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "And Noach found favor in the eyes of Hashem" (ו׳נח מ׳צא ח׳ן ב׳עיני י׳י) [Genesis 6:8] spell מביחו (meviacho — a word whose meaning is developed in the source).
 
 
 Chayay Mooharan §463
